name: img-val
description: TypeScript CLI for LLM-based image valuation

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @llm-image/shared build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const pairs=[['assets/standards/builtin','standards/builtin'],['src/storage/migrations','storage/migrations']];for(const [s,d] of pairs){const src=path.join(s),dst=path.join('dist',d);fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});}"
